_contract: DAY 2 - the three hook variants for the Steel and Paper re-post. 8s each (E24: the first chart lands spotlit at 8-20s, the hook covers 0-8s). reverse:true so each ENDS pixel-exact on the title world for the handoff. If Frames sub-mode accepts an END frame, prefer it over reversal: submode 'frames' with the plate as the end frame - test on one variant first.
